procedure: 08_Evidence_Ledger.md check mode AS WRITTEN (pre-calibration). Blind: only csv_row, universe and justification text were read. Option codes: INC = Non-Fail Incomplete (Completeness), INA = Non-Fail Inaccurate (Accuracy), MIN = Non-Fail Minor (Accuracy), UNMAPPED = playbook gives no QC label, NA = no finding derivable. QC score = 3 for INC/INA/MIN per the playbook's QC Spec V2 column.

2: event uses an ID nothing before it produced (completeness list)
3: wrong parameter value (entry flag) + expected open items understated
4: imprecise date that does not change the path (Minor clause)
5: unnecessary purpose in a lookup -> 'redundant or unnecessary events' row, QC column '-'
6: tool name not in catalog (airtable_update_records) -> 'tool exists' fails; expected notes overstated
7: email ID passed as search query -> parameter does not match locator
8: unsupported parameter (content vs payload) -> wrong parameter
9: expected invoices do not exist -> expected values mismatch
10: wrong parameter names -> parameters do not match
11: conclusion contradicted by timestamps -> expected value wrong
12: state_id null not done -> expected value mismatch
13: events name no ID where the locator needs one (completeness list)
15: offered tool cannot filter -> tool/parameter wrong
17: CRM fact attached to email/Slack -> wrong service
18: fact in expected data no event retrieves (CRM lookup)
19: folder filter missing -> filter does not match locator
20: nonexistent email, wrong sender/date, wrong tool names
21: tool names not in catalog; one-service-only lookup; OR branch
23: count stated in the event contradicts the universe (not a rounding/date case)
24: loan number paired with the wrong borrower
26: same bill treated two ways; conflicting end states
27: approximate figure that does not change the path
28: count wrong (four vs six); false tool-absence claim
29: expected balance on new bill wrong
30: expected 'no dispute' contradicted by a CRM engagement
32: parameter name assignee_id vs assignee -> wrong parameter
34: analysis/mapping/dedup method missing (jump with analysis missing)
35: draft branch would not produce the correct trajectory
38: events give no expected data (completeness list: 'no expected data')
39: prescribes a write for a designed absence
40: expected IDs from the wrong service namespace
